description: Owner-visible projection of the exact persisted command plan.

executionBasis.description:
The trust basis under which an execution draft was produced.

This is classification metadata. It is compared as part of the full draft
but deliberately excluded from the worker-field fingerprint.

oneOf.description:
Present for an interactive (PTY) command: the client opens a terminal
carrier for exactly this execution before approving.

elevated.description: The command runs `sudo`/`doas`; the owner may be asked for a password.

execRequestId.description: Server-derived execution id the carrier is prepared for.

targetConnectionId.description: Host connection the command runs on.
